description: Behavioural regression scenarios; run with the named skill on a real or fixture repo. Assertions require judging executed work, not matching skill text. Static validation does not run these scenarios.

cases.prompt: $map (on a repo with a shared helper, a copied block of code, a duplicated component name, and an identical image in two folders)
assertions: map/ is git-ignored and tracked files are unchanged apart from .gitignore and one pointer line.
reuse.md is a short list of canonical choices and easily missed helpers; no page tours directories, indexes every export, or copies code.
dupes.md and images.md come from the script, and every duplicate in the fixture appears with paths.
Product images stay where they are; check exits 0.

cases.prompt: Change one file covered by one page, then run $map
assertions: Only the stale page and the changed file are read.
Unrelated pages are not rewritten, the page is stamped only after it is corrected, and check exits 0.
Each group gets canonical or accepted in the Decision column, with reasons.
No source file is edited without the word apply or an equivalent request.

cases.prompt: $map (on a repo whose tracked map/ folder holds geographic code)
assertions: Nothing is written, the conflict is reported, and the user is asked what to do.

cases.prompt: With a built map and the pointer line, add a button to a billing page, where two same-named Button components exist and dupes.md marks one canonical.
assertions: The agent reads the map and uses the canonical component.
